edition.title: AI & Climate: Reimagining the Future Together
edition.description: Artificial Intelligence is transforming the way we work, learn, communicate and solve problems. At the same time, climate change demands new ways of thinking, collaborating and innovating. The Festival brings these two worlds together to ask: how can technology help us build a better future — and what responsibilities come with that power? Through student-led performances, films, innovations, talks, conversations and interactive experiences, Purple Umbrella 2026 creates a space to explore these questions together.
